top_band: tiled roof slope (rows 1-14) and stone basin top rim/water surface (rows 29-35) in blue-grey and light grey tones
evidence: The structure clearly shows a 14-row foreshortened tiled roof slope on top (rows 1-14) with an underside eave shadow (rows 15-17), supported by vertical pillars (rows 17-42), and a stone water basin at the bottom showing both its horizontal top rim/recessed water opening (rows 29-35) and its vertical front face (rows 36-42) with an overhang shadow on row 36.

style.evidence: While the roof tiles have decent shading (5 steps of blue-grey), the wooden pillars and the stone basin below are rendered with completely flat fills (a 13x6 solid grey block on the front of the basin, and ungrained 2-colour vertical bands for the wood pillars) enclosed in heavy near-black outlines, lacking the rich stone/wood grain texture of the Beodeul references.
